text.p: -- Everen Securities Inc said Tuesday it was lowering its intermediate-term rating on First Michigan Bank Corp to market performer from outperformer. Long-term rating remains outperform.
-- The rating change comes the day after Huntington Bancshares Inc agreed to acquire First Michigan for 1.05 shares of Huntington for each First Michigan share.
-- Everen says its target price for Huntington is $31 and with the 1.05 exchange ratio, the upside for First Michigan is limited in the near-term, Everen said in a research report.

-- Everen also noted what it considered a rich premium for the acquisition and and a lock-up provision in the deal, saying the likelihood of another acquirer stepping in at a higher price is quite low.
-- First Michigan shares were unchanged at 29-3/4 and Huntington shares were down 5/16 at 29-5/16 Tuesday.
